title: SseQueueEvent
description: One event of the live queue stream, GET /api/egress/stream on the admin daemon (spa mode, session cookie required). On the wire an event is `event: queue` and one `data:` line carrying the whole queue_snapshot() as compact JSON; this schema is that event as an object, {event, data}. The stream sends the current snapshot at once on connect and again whenever it changes, ignoring `generated_at` and each open row's `age_seconds`, which change on every poll. A `: hb` comment line every 15 s keeps an idle stream alive (a comment is not an event). At most 8 streams are open at once; a ninth, or a connect while the broker is unreachable, gets 503 with an error_response body. There is no error event: when the broker stays unreachable the daemon ends the streams and the app falls back to polling GET /api/egress/queue.

event.$comment: The stream carries queue_snapshot() updates only.
